about: Ransom's Rest's town buildings re-finished with no new draw (Docs/Work/2026-11-04-Towns/PLAN.md 4.2 item 1; round 2 2026-11-04, Main: the plan's tints read as almost nothing, the user wants variety a player sees): each building's roof (the house trim's shake strip E: grey, how far it goes grey first, then tint, a linear multiplier: silver-grey weathered shakes, honey cedar, dark tar paper, mossy), siding (its weathered boards, strip A: tint, the bare boards' stain; paint, an sRGB colour, none is whitewash cream 0xe6dac2; wash, how much paint covers them, the gaps between boards stay bare) and porch (the H1 teal and H2 oxide-red trim boards swapped or not), read by M_World's TrimRecolor (on MI_HouseTrim) from the building's custom primitive data 0-11, set by Tools/Unreal/build_area_town_looks.py after the build. Sun-faded frontier paint, never saturated: chalk white, sage, grey-blue (Slate), mustard (Ochre), barn red gone brick; Silvered is bare boards gone grey, Tar tarred boards, Bare the boards as they are. Lived vs shut (D5, the plan's types): lived homes and open shops wear fresh paint (wash 0.85-0.9) and every honey roof; shut ones faded paint (0.55-0.6) or bare boards under silver, moss or tar-paper roofs. buildings: by placement id (the actor's label); roofKit names a roof that isn't the shake strip (Home_J's planks, Home_E's sod: no tint, and it differs from every tinted roof). sides: buildings in order along a street side: consecutive ones differ in roof AND siding AND porch; facing: across Main Street (its two sides) any pair whose placements stand within facingReach cm along the street differs in 2 of the 3. The script refuses a table that breaks either rule and prints the pairs.
